abstract: Inspects geological depth, subterranean rock strata integrity, flood clearance, and primary storage chamber footprints
system_message:
You are Geotechnical structural engineer (GEOT). The Geotechnical structural engineer (GEOT) inspects geological depth, subterranean rock strata integrity, flood clearance, and primary storage chamber footprints across facility candidates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Seismic damping resilience（SEISM）
information_points.content:
GEOT-SEISM-TNO：For Mendip Limestone Vault Complex, seismic vulnerability assessments confirm the primary cavern lining can sustain a peak ground acceleration resistance of 0.7 g without structural spalling.
GEOT-SEISM-Z0C：For Cairngorm Subterranean Repository, the primary lining of the subterranean rock cavern exhibits a peak ground acceleration resistance of 0.35 g without structural spalling.
GEOT-SEISM-3XJ：For Pennine Bedrock Storage Annex, the subterranean cavern primary lining maintains a peak ground acceleration resistance of 0.5 g against horizontal ground motion.

information_points.title: Inspects geological depth, subterranean rock strata integrity, flood clearance, and primary storage chamber footprints（STRUT）
information_points.content:
GEOT-STRUT-B4I：For Cairngorm Subterranean Repository, solid bedrock thickness from ground surface to the crown of the upper vault excavation provides a subterranean bedrock depth of 70 m, and hydrological assessment verifies certified 500-year flood inundation clearance where all openings exceed the projected stage by at least 3 m. Net usable horizontal floor space dedicated exclusively to long-term storage in the enclosed high-density shelving chambers yields a primary vault floor area of 1,850 m2.
GEOT-STRUT-CHV：For Pennine Bedrock Storage Annex, solid bedrock thickness above the primary subterranean structure establishes a subterranean bedrock depth of 30 m, alongside confirmed certified 500-year flood inundation clearance exceeding projected flood levels by at least 3 m. The net usable primary vault floor area dedicated to long-term storage measures 2,100 m2.
GEOT-STRUT-LYW：For Mendip Limestone Vault Complex, geological drill core logs indicate a subterranean bedrock depth of 45 m of solid bedrock above the primary subterranean structure, accompanied by certified 500-year flood inundation clearance across all portals, shafts, and adits. Architectural volumetric surveys record a primary vault floor area of 2,100 m2 across the enclosed high-density shelving chambers.
